description: Register smart-products shortcode with admin configuration (title, criteria dropdown, items_to_show, items_per_page, load_more_type, category filter) and Blade template. Shortcode renders initial products server-side, includes hidden metadata for AJAX pagination. Template matches featured-products.blade.php grid layout (6-column responsive grid, same CSS classes). Uses product-card-enhanced.blade.php partial for each product with layout='flyout'. Load more options: 'button' (Load More button), 'auto' (IntersectionObserver infinite scroll), 'none' (show items_to_show only).
steps: Add shortcode registration after existing product shortcodes (after 'trending-products' block, before 'flash-sale'): add_shortcode('smart-products', __('Smart Products'), __('Smart Products'), function ($shortCode) { ... })
In shortcode callback: resolve SmartProductService from container: $service = app('Botble\Ecommerce\Services\Products\SmartProductService')

Call service method based on criteria: switch($criteria) { case 'most_viewed': $products = $service->getMostViewed($itemsToShow, $categoryId); break; case 'most_sold': ...; case 'trending': $service->getTrending($itemsToShow, $categoryId, 7); etc. }

Add admin config via shortcode()->setAdminConfig('smart-products', function($attributes) { return ShortcodeForm::createFromArray($attributes)->withLazyLoading()->add('title', TextField::class, ...)->add('criteria', SelectField::class, SelectFieldOption::make()->label(__('Criteria'))->choices(['most_viewed' => 'Most Viewed', 'most_sold' => 'Best Sellers', 'trending' => 'Trending', 'most_wishlisted' => 'Most Wishlisted', 'best_rated' => 'Best Rated', 'most_added_to_cart' => 'Most Added to Cart', 'similar_products' => 'Similar Products'])->defaultValue('most_viewed'))->add('items_to_show', NumberField::class, NumberFieldOption::make()->label(__('Total items to show'))->defaultValue(12))->add('items_per_page', NumberField::class, NumberFieldOption::make()->label(__('Items per page (for Load More)'))->defaultValue(6))->add('load_more_type', SelectField::class, SelectFieldOption::make()->label(__('Load More Type'))->choices(['none' => 'None', 'button' => 'Load More Button', 'auto' => 'Auto Load (Infinite Scroll)'])->defaultValue('button'))->add('category_id', SelectField::class, SelectFieldOption::make()->label(__('Filter by category (optional)'))->choices(['' => __('All Categories')] + ProductCategory::wherePublished()->pluck('name', 'id')->toArray())); })

In Blade template: copy structure from featured-products.blade.php -

{{ $title }}

After grid close: @if($loadMoreType !== 'none' && $products->count() >= $itemsPerPage)
{{ __('Loading...') }}
@endif
Reuse existing CSS from featured-products.blade.php - no new styles needed, classes already defined
acceptance_criteria: Shortcode 'smart-products' appears in admin shortcode picker
Admin config form shows all 7 criteria options in dropdown
Admin config includes items_to_show, items_per_page, load_more_type, category_id fields
Inserting [smart-products title="Top Products" criteria="most_sold"] renders products on page
Grid uses ps-grid--featured class and matches featured-products layout exactly
Each product renders via product-card-enhanced.blade.php with layout='flyout'
Load More button appears when loadMoreType='button' and products.count >= itemsPerPage
No Load More button when loadMoreType='none'
Grid has data attributes: data-criteria, data-category-id, data-load-more-type, data-items-per-page, data-current-page, data-total-shown
verification: Visit WordPress/Botble admin, insert [smart-products title="Trending Now" criteria="trending" items_to_show="12" items_per_page="6" load_more_type="button"] into a page
View page frontend - verify 6 products display in grid matching featured-products layout
Verify Load More button exists below grid
Inspect grid element - verify data-criteria="trending", data-items-per-page="6", data-current-page="1"
Test category filter: insert shortcode with category_id="5" - verify only products from that category appear
Test load_more_type="none" - verify no Load More button appears
Responsive test: view on mobile - grid should collapse to 1 column below 480px per featured-products CSS
